briefs.rationale: Rewrote the part brief so the ordinal, combinatorial, descriptive-set, logic, PCF, reflection, Boolean and large-cardinal strands stay readable, and integrated both gained pages: canonical Skolem hulls and condensation in L yielding GCH, diamond under V=L and the Suslin tree with the finite-fragment consistency transfer, then forcing from generics and names through the truth lemma to generic ZF/ZFC extensions and the formal consistency transfer.

Rewrote the brief so the normed-space, Baire, Fourier, Hahn--Banach, dual-space and locally convex narrative continues into both gained pages: distributions defined through the LF test-function topology and the local finite-order criterion, with derivatives, support and structure and their stated choice hypotheses; and the weak and weak-star topologies with their continuous duals, convex closure, boundedness and operator-topology comparisons.

Rewrote the brief to keep the measure, integration, L^p, representation, differentiation and interpolation strands, tighten the Koopman and weak-mixing sentences to what the mixing page proves, and fold in the gained page: Poincare recurrence, first-return maps with Kac's formula, circle rotations and expanding maps, the fair-coin shift and Krylov--Bogolyubov, ending on the three-cut Chacon transformation.
